_provenance: Committed bridge between Layer-A measurements and the sweep (D-010). Every number here traces to a committed artifact: capacity/latency/energy from results/layer_a/slots_*.json (campaign 2026-08-02); accuracy from results/accuracy_probe.json; switch times measured launch-to-healthy 2026-08-02 (D-010); episode constants from PROTOCOL Sec. 2/7.
_init_rule: smallest r among configs with measured capacity >= 1.2 x mean offered rate (2.4 rps); tie-break highest measured accuracy. tiny-1B4@2 (3.15 rps, acc 0.722) beats lite-1B@2 (3.50 rps, acc 0.694) on the accuracy tie-break at equal cost.
_slo_rule: PROTOCOL Sec. 7: T set so static and heuristic arms can plausibly meet it at moderate load. full-3B single-stream p95 = 2.57 s < 3.0 s (feasible unloaded); under batching contention full-3B p95 reaches 3.9-4.8 s (breaches) - the accuracy/latency trade-off is real, not degenerate.
_volatility_note: v1.3 amendment: I=4000 (protocol v1 core) is unreachable at mean 2.0 rps with the fixed MMPP(2) shape (duty 0.06, burst 20 s): required rate gap d = sqrt((I-1)*mean*(q_hi+q_lo)/(2*p_hi*p_lo)) = 61.4 rps > mean/duty = 33.3 rps => negative low-state rate. Ceiling at this scale is I ~= 1177; core set {1, 400, 1000}. Mean rate itself is capped by measured max capacity 4.70 rps (lite-1B, 6 slots).
